character_tex: Frenkel-Kac-Wakimoto characters $\chi_{(\lambda;\mu)} = \eta(\tau)^{-2}\sum_{w\in W(A_2)}\epsilon(w)\sum_{\alpha\in Q} q^{|p'(\lambda+\rho)-p\,w(\mu+\rho)+pp'\alpha|^2/2pp'}$, $p'=p+1$, with $\lambda = (\lambda_1,\lambda_2)$ a level-$(p-3)$ and $\mu = (\mu_1,\mu_2)$ a level-$(p-2)$ $SU(3)$ weight in Dynkin labels, $(\lambda;\mu)\sim(\sigma\lambda;\sigma\mu)$ under the $\mathbb{Z}_3$ rotation of affine Dynkin labels; $h = \frac{|p'(\lambda+\rho)-p(\mu+\rho)|^2-|\rho|^2}{2pp'}$. Here $p = 11$.
description: Diagonal modular invariant of the $\mathcal{W}_3(11,12)$ minimal model $SU(3)_{8}\times SU(3)_1/SU(3)_{9}$ (Fateev-Zamolodchikov 1987; Fateev-Lukyanov 1988): 825 $\mathcal{W}_3$ primaries, characters from the Frenkel-Kac-Wakimoto formula.
